content.name: Brianna Lopez
content.title: IT Support Specialist
content.summary: CompTIA A+ and Network+ certified support specialist with two years of hands-on work, first at a computer repair shop and now as the sole on-site IT person for a 12-office dental group. Keeps first-contact resolution near 80% and rebuilt the group's laptop setup process from half a day to under an hour. Bilingual in English and Spanish.

experience.title: Repair Technician (part-time)
bullets: Diagnosed and repaired about 25 laptops and desktops a week, from failed drives and malware to cracked screens.
Recovered data for walk-in customers and explained repair options in English or Spanish before quoting.
Organized the parts inventory into labeled bins and a shared sheet, so finding a part took under a minute instead of five during busy weeks.

experience.title: IT Support Specialist
bullets: Support 160 staff across 12 dental offices, closing around 220 tickets a month with 79% resolved on first contact.
Built a Windows Autopilot and Intune enrollment process that cut new-laptop setup from four hours to 50 minutes.
Replaced aging Wi-Fi access points in five offices, ending the daily dropouts that interrupted digital X-ray uploads.
Enforced multi-factor authentication for all Microsoft 365 accounts and trained front-desk staff to spot phishing, supporting the group's HIPAA safeguards.

education.details: GPA 3.5/4.0. President's Honor Roll, three semesters.

achievements.title: Employee of the Quarter, Mission Trail Dental Group
achievements.detail: Nominated by office managers after the Wi-Fi replacement project.

achievements.title: Volunteer, library tech help hours
achievements.detail: Help older adults set up phones, email and telehealth apps two Saturdays a month.

skills: Customer service in English and Spanish
